meta.title: Privacy notice | Larch Street Library
meta.description: What the library website collects, why we keep it, and your rights.

body: Larch Street Library is the controller for this website. We run it, and we are responsible for your data.
The site sets no cookies and has no forms. Our web host keeps a short log of each visit: your IP address, the time and the page. The purpose is to keep the site safe and working.
Our legal basis is our public task, and our interest in a safe site.
We keep these logs for 30 days. Then they are deleted.
The host keeps the logs in the EU. We do not send them to other countries.
You have rights over your data. You have the right to access it, to correct it and to ask us to delete it.
To use a right, contact us by email at privacy@example.org. You can also complain to your data protection authority.
This notice was last updated in November 2026.
